g.text: HERBALIST
plants + mixtures;
biggest group,
refer both ways!
TBA
trusted births;
train + slips +
thank referrals!
BONE-SETTER
splints fractures;
praise simple,
refer complex!
SPIRITUALIST
prayer + rituals;
coordinate,
unchain!
HERBALISTS: diagnose by history + observation + spiritual insight; treat with leaves,
barks, roots (decoctions! poultices! enemas! baths!). Strengths: near + affordable + trusted
+ time-rich. Partner: greet, ask formulas (respectfully!), safety-check (M03!), refer BOTH
ways ("fever 3 days? hospital too — I'll call ahead!").
TBAs: 1st call for labour (near! kind! cheap! rituals!). Train: clean delivery + danger
signs + REFERRAL SLIPS + transport plans + phone numbers. Praise EVERY referral ("you
saved two lives today!") — shamed TBAs hide complications. Never war — alliance.
BONE-SETTERS: palpate + pull + splint (sticks! bandages! herbs!). Good: closed simple
fractures + sprains. DANGER: tight splints (gangrene! Volkmann!), open fractures, joints,
spine. Teach: looseness + finger-checks + REFER list (numb? pale? cold? open? — hospital
TODAY!). Amputations from splints = preventable tragedy — workshops work.
SPIRITUALISTS/PASTORS: "spiritual" illness (madness! infertility! bad luck!), prayer camps,
fasting, deliverance. Coordinate: pray AND prescribe ("God guides the drip!") · chaining/
beating/starving REFUSED + reported (Mental Health Act! BEH M06!) · fasting + drugs
scheduled · detention negotiated out ("treat here, pray here too!").
REFERRAL ETIQUETTE: write slips (findings + "please see…") · phone ahead · receive BACK
graciously ("thank you for sending early!") · feedback given ("baby fine — your call saved
her!") · names + numbers exchanged. Two-way respect = two-way referrals.
DOCUMENT: healer consulted + treatment given + coordination + referrals (INF!). "Herbalist
Kofi: neem decoction 3 days — advised continue + ORS + return signs" continues care.
LINKS: BEH beliefs · COM trust · NUT myths · M06 law.
MANTRA: "greet, learn, safety-check, refer both ways, thank."
